state_snapshot.overall_goal: Make the app's static text translatable across all screens, excluding data sourced from the backend.
state_snapshot.key_knowledge: - Localization is implemented using 'react-i18next' with a 'useTranslation' hook and 't()' function. - Translation files are 'en.json' and 'ar.json', located in 'src/services/locales/'. - Consistent issues with file pathing and naming (e.g., 'ClinicDetail' vs. 'ClinicDetailScreen', 'ConsulationPayment' vs. 'ConsultationPayment', 'VedioConsultation' vs. 'VideoConsultation') require careful verification. - Translation involves updating JSON files with new keys and modifying component files to use the 't()' function.
